title: Unforgettable architecture and sunset from Matanga Hill
content: Exploring the Vijaya Vittala temple complex and the stone chariot in person exceeded all expectations. Hiring a certified ASI guide at the entrance is highly recommended to appreciate the acoustic pillars and carvings. Carry water and wear comfortable walking shoes.

title: Virupaksha temple morning pooja is divine
content: Arriving early around 7:00 AM gives you calm and peace before day crowds arrive. Anegundi village across the river is equally historic and serene.

title: Chalukyan rock-cut caves are breathtaking
content: Cave 3 dedicated to Lord Vishnu and the 18-armed Nataraja in Cave 1 showcase supreme 6th-century craftsmanship. The view of Agastya Lake with Bhutanatha temple on the banks in the golden evening light is unforgettable.

title: Palace illumination is a must-see spectacle
content: The intricate woodwork, stained glass dome in the marriage pavilion, and golden throne are majestic. Make sure to visit on Sunday evening between 7:00 PM and 8:00 PM when the entire palace is illuminated with nearly 100,000 bulbs.

title: Magnificent post-monsoon roar of the four cascades
content: Raja, Roarer, Rocket, and Rani plunges were in full glory. Walking down the steps to the base gives a misty shower experience. Visit on weekdays to avoid weekend vehicle traffic.
